name: Addiction tracker
tagline: Addiction Tracker - An app for tracking substance addiction and habits
blurb: Your journey to recovery starts here.
description:
Your journey to recovery starts here. Track your progress, identify triggers, and celebrate milestones on your path to a healthier life.

• ✔ Understand Your Triggers - Feeling blindsided by sudden urges? Identify patterns and triggers that lead to substance use, so you can prepare and respond effectively.

• ✔ See the Financial Impact - Shocked by how much money disappears? Track your spending on substances and visualize what you could save for things that truly matter.

• ✔ Remember Your Why - Struggling to stay motivated? Store personal motivations and access them instantly when cravings hit to strengthen your resolve.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
